title: Attachments
drop: Drop files or paste a screenshot here
limit: Up to 256 MiB per file. Two concurrent transfers per queue.
unavailable: This data source has no attachment service.
problem.tooLarge: The file exceeds the 256 MiB limit.
problem.nameInvalid: The filename contains a path, control characters, or an invalid name.
problem.queueFull: The queue holds at most 64 items. Clear completed items first.
problem.ownerInvalid: The attachment owner ID is invalid.
problem.idInvalid: The attachment ID is invalid or duplicated.
problem.notReady: The upload connection is not ready.
problem.cancelUnknown: Transfer canceled. The server may have committed it. Refresh the list or retry the original ID.
problem.receiptMismatch: The server receipt does not match this upload. Check the list.
problem.refreshCommitted: The operation committed, but the list did not refresh. Refresh the list.
problem.unlinkFailed: The reference was not removed. Check the object state and retry.
problem.integrity: File integrity verification failed. No download was produced.
problem.unknown: The operation failed. Check the connection, object state, and service logs before retrying.
